protocol.decoding: full undecomposed joint X/Z detector DEM for each memory experiment; no split into detector sectors
protocol.metric: (X-memory observable error rate + Z-memory observable error rate)/12; nonconvergence recorded separately
protocol.numeric_profile: canonical float64 total-minus min-sum, alpha1 offset0, hard tie1; native arithmetic/RNG separate
protocol.resources: 50 process workers per paired decoder/code/rate point, shared across X/Z memories
protocol.sampling: sealed shared Stim detector/observable bytes per code/rate/basis; persisted bytes authoritative across SIMD producers
protocol.stopping: 20 observable errors or100M shots per memory basis, exact ordered prefix
protocol.uncertainty: 97.5% exact capped component intervals summed/cycles; at least95% pointwise X/Z coverage
